command:
backlog task edit APRV-276 --plan "1. Contract (src/adapters/contract.ts): add an OPTIONAL Adapter.precheck(input) run in the pre-token phase APRV-169 established (after resolveRequiredCredentials, before startExecution), inside its own credential window with APRV-168's presented-phase grant live. A refusal appends nothing, spends no token, and returns the new frozen code adapter-precheck-refused with acted:false and the adapter's own reason in adapter_code. A throw is caught and refused the same way (fail closed: nothing was attempted).
2. AgentMail (src/adapters/agentmail.ts): implement precheck for DRAFT mode only - mode/shape, inbox-mismatch, draft read, draftDrift - reusing the same helpers act uses. Direct mode returns ok (its payload is fully bound by the payload hash; there is no server-mutable object to compare). act keeps its own drift check unchanged: the pre-spend one protects the grant, the in-window one binds the bytes actually sent and closes the TOCTOU between the comparison and the POST. The draft is therefore read twice on the happy path.
3. Decision (c) of the task, documented: the token layer already separates verification from consumption (core/token.ts verifyToken vs consumeToken) and the contract already mints a presented-phase grant on a digest match against the human's grant. The comparison uses the SAME vault sending key, read through the contract's pre-token credential window; not the caller's AGENTMAIL_API_KEY, because a comparison whose input the party under oversight chooses is scrutiny the agent controls (SPEC 11.1 invariant 4).
4. SPEC.md 10.4: amend the AgentMail paragraph to say the comparison runs before the token is consumed and which key performs it, marked (Amended APRV-276, pending sign-off.). Adapter module doc updated to match.
5. Tests: tests/adapter-agentmail.test.ts gains drift-then-restore-then-send on ONE token (drift: no execution.started, token still verifies; restore: started+completed; third run: token-consumed) and the existing drift/draft-missing expectations move to the pre-spend code; tests/adapters-contract.test.ts pins the extended frozen union and a contract-level precheck refusal that leaves the log byte-identical and the token spendable.
6. docs/cli-reference.md: the ordered step list for adapter agentmail matches the code.
7. Verify: npm run build, adapter/token/execute suites, lint, typecheck, full npm test." 2>&1 | tail -3
